decisions: extract_modules.py refuses any new module that reads a name left in the residue, so every assignment here is downward closed: the residue sits at the top of the dependency order and imports its children.

The map keeps ViewTag and UnrankableNumber in __init__.py, which both children read, so that shape is refused. They take a named home, views/view_tag.py, and the package __init__ keeps only its docstring. That is not a re-export shim: every reader is repointed at the named module and __init__ exports nothing.
view_tag.py, not tags.py: program/tagged.py is the tagged number in the sibling package, and two modules called tags would read as the same idea.

BLOCKER: scripts/module_readers.py matches a reader against Source.dotted, which for a package __init__ is 'src.calculator.program.views.__init__' and never matches 'from ..views import ViewTag'. Check mode reports 0 reader sites and --write would leave every importer pointing at names that moved. Strip a trailing '__init__' from Source.dotted before running this file.
